title: RunRecord
description: What a run pinned at open. Key `run:<label>`.

answerer_family.description:
The family of the model answering the run's encode and lowering
prompts, set once at open; `Unrecorded` when the opener did not say
and for a run opened before this was kept.

corpus.description: Canonical absolute path of the corpus store.

corpus_digest.description: 16 hex of the corpus file's bytes.

inventory.description:
Canonical absolute path of the inventory store the run was opened over:
provenance only. `create` copies that file to `<root>/inventory.cc` and
the run reads nothing at this path afterwards.

inventory_digest.description: 16 hex of the bytes `create` copied to `<root>/inventory.cc`.

lowerer_reach.description: How the run's lowering prompts are answered, set once at open.

panel.description:
The languages the run offers, reads and decides on: BCP 47-form tags,
sorted, unique, at least one, set once at open. An item of any other
language is never offered, minted from, probed or scored.

LowererReach.description:
How a run's lowering prompts reach the model that answers them (rulings
`lowerer-call-reach-toolless-relay`, `dao-round-seed-inventory`). The
record says which, so a round lowered by a briefed subagent cannot pass as
a tool-less one.

oneOf.description:
A subagent briefed to read one prompt file: acceptable for smoke rounds
only.
The prompt passed inline to an agent with no file tools.

ModelFamily.description: The family of the model that wrote a line.

oneOf.description: Nothing records which family wrote the line.
